stage2_context_review: Castellon strength and absences supported a goals angle, but the preserved counterargument that Ceuta might contribute little was directionally closer to the failure mode.
note: Over 2.5 lost 1-1. After the decision, absolute Over money grew only modestly while selected share fell about 7 points and price reopened 1.39 to 1.42. Research candidate: late weakening of both concentration and price may deserve a confidence downgrade on short-priced totals, but Malta-Andorra is an immediate counterexample, so this must be tested across many cases.
